task: replace hardcoded values with real computation

desc: Boltz-2 predictions vs legacy hardcoded values

text: Boltz-2 v2.2.1 (MIT) runs locally on Apple MPS and predicted a 36-residue platform candidate in 7 seconds, emitting a real mmCIF, per-residue pLDDT, a 36x36 PAE matrix and a confidence JSON. This replaces the charCode-derived helix and the sine-wave pLDDT.

AlphaFold3 cannot be an automated backend: weights are request-only and non-redistributable, and the AlphaFold Server prohibited-use policy forbids automated protein-ligand and protein-peptide binding prediction. Boltz-2 is used instead. This is a licensing substitution, not a claim of scientific equivalence.

The ESM Atlas fold API serves cached results only. Measured 2026-08-17: a well-known 33-mer returns in 0.7 s with a 2022 HEADER date; any novel sequence, including a 20-mer, returns HTTP 504. It must not be used as a predictor.

AutoDock Vina publishes no macOS arm64 wheel (Linux x86_64 only) and its source build does not locate Homebrew Boost, so Vina docking is unavailable on this machine. Peptide-protein affinity should use PRODIGY's published regression instead, which needs only a structure.

ADMET-AI 2.0.1 runs locally and returns 104 endpoints in 0.2 s. Sanity checks pass: Huperzine A BBB_Martins 0.920 (a real CNS drug), curcumin 0.153 (poor CNS exposure), curcumin DILI 0.803 (matching its hepatotoxicity signal).

The ADMET layer REFUSES to emit values for peptides and anything above 1000 Da, because TDC training sets contain no such chemistry. This is the direct remediation of the legacy platform applying a small-molecule hERG number to all 25 multi-kDa polycationic peptides.

Boltz predictions with a single chain return iptm = 0.0 by construction, because ipTM measures interface confidence and there is no interface. No legacy candidate was ever predicted against its stated receptor, so no legacy value could have carried binding information.

Head-to-head on 6 candidates: the legacy pLDDT values disagree with real Boltz-2 predictions by up to 34.9 units. Worst case PfcACh-PAM-P1: claimed 93.2, computed 58.3. One candidate happened to match within 0.3 units, which is coincidence and not vindication -- a designed amphipathic helix is exactly the case a predictor is confident about, and confidence in a fold says nothing about binding.
